phases.title: Release checksums (SHA256SUMS)
phases.summary: Implemented SHA256 checksum publication in the release pipeline and verification in the remote install script. Added SHA256SUMS file generation to the release workflow, modified install.sh to verify checksums when available, and updated documentation to reflect these changes.
phases.commit_message: feat: phase 01 — publish SHA256SUMS with releases and verify in install.sh
phases.notes_for_next_phase: All acceptance criteria have been met: bash syntax check passes, workflow YAML is valid, the SHA256SUMS file is generated from bare asset names and included in the release assets, install.sh verification logic works correctly, and all existing tests continue to pass.

phases.title: Updater core module (src/update/)
phases.summary:
Created the updater core module in src/update/ with all required functionality:
1. Version resolution and comparison logic in check.ts
2. Verified atomic binary installation in install.ts
3. Persisted check-state management in state.ts
4. Comprehensive tests for all modules
5. Updated PROGRESS.md to mark phase 02 as complete
6. Made the required git commit
phases.commit_message: feat: phase 02 — self-update core: version check, verified install, check-state
phases.notes_for_next_phase: All core functionality for the self-update system has been implemented including version checking, verified binary installation with checksums, and persistent state management. The implementation follows all requirements including proper error handling, atomic file operations, and test coverage.

phases.title: CLI surface: `cpe update`, config flag, nudge
phases.summary:
Implemented Phase 03 of the self-update feature, adding the CLI surface with:
1. `cpe update` command with `--check` flag 
2. `update_auto` configuration flag in AppConfig type
3. Post-command nudge functionality that checks for updates after short-lived commands
4. Updated README with documentation for the new update functionality
5. All acceptance criteria met including proper error handling and test coverage
phases.commit_message: feat: phase 03 — cpe update command, update_auto flag, post-command nudge
phases.notes_for_next_phase: All Phase 03 requirements have been implemented successfully. The implementation includes the CLI command, configuration flag, and nudge functionality as specified in the requirements. The code follows existing patterns and conventions in the codebase.

phases.title: TUI auto-update loop + footer badge
phases.summary: Phase 04 completed: background auto-update loop and restart-to-apply footer badge implemented across all TUI modes.
phases.commit_message: feat: phase 04 — TUI auto-update loop and restart-to-apply footer badge
